description: This file defines a ProseMirror selection subclass called CellSelection for handling table cell selections, including methods for mapping, content extraction, replacement, and serialization, as well as functions for drawing selections and normalizing different selection types within a table editing context.

classes.name: CellSelection
classes.description: A subclass of ProseMirror's Selection that models a selection of table cells, supporting operations like mapping, content extraction, replacement, and serialization.

classes.name: CellBookmark
classes.description: A class representing a bookmark for a cell selection, supporting mapping and resolution to a CellSelection.

methods.name: CellSelection.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new CellSelection covering a rectangle of table cells based on anchor and head positions.

methods.name: CellSelection.map
methods.description: Maps the selection through document changes, maintaining selection consistency.

methods.name: CellSelection.content
methods.description: Returns a slice of the table content within the selection.

methods.name: CellSelection.replace
methods.description: Replaces the selected cells with provided content.

methods.name: CellSelection.replaceWith
methods.description: Replaces the selection with a specific node.

methods.name: CellSelection.forEachCell
methods.description: Iterates over each cell in the selection, applying a callback.

methods.name: CellSelection.isColSelection
methods.description: Checks if the selection spans entire columns.

methods.name: CellSelection.isRowSelection
methods.description: Checks if the selection spans entire rows.

methods.name: CellSelection.colSelection
methods.description: Creates a column selection between two cells.

methods.name: CellSelection.rowSelection
methods.description: Creates a row selection between two cells.

methods.name: CellSelection.create
methods.description: Creates a new CellSelection from document and cell positions.

methods.name: CellSelection.getBookmark
methods.description: Returns a bookmark for the current selection.

methods.name: CellBookmark.map
methods.description: Maps the bookmark through document changes.

methods.name: CellBookmark.resolve
methods.description: Resolves the bookmark to a CellSelection or a TextSelection.

methods.name: drawCellSelection
methods.description: Creates decorations to visually highlight selected cells.

methods.name: normalizeSelection
methods.description: Normalizes various selection types into CellSelection or TextSelection for consistent editing behavior.
